feature: PDF redaction verifier: flag text whose glyphs sit under filled rectangles/black boxes and show the recoverable words (browser port of the x-ray approach)
competitor_gap: x-ray is Python/CLI only; generic metadata removers do not check redactions; ReactPDF audit unknown
dependency_risk: low-medium (pdf.js text positions + operator parsing; already have pdf-lib)
privacy_risk: low (local; must not log recovered text)
notes: Implemented 2026-11-27 (commit eff533aa) by rendering pages with pdf.js and testing word areas for visible contrast rather than parsing operators; catches black boxes over part of a run and whole-run white-out. Biggest differentiator and news-driven (EV-003/EV-006). Must state it detects the common rectangle-over-text failure only, and never claim a file is 'safe'. Give it its own landing page that reuses the Share-Safe engine. Top priority.

feature: Re-scan the cleaned copy and report only what the re-scan confirms as removed
competitor_gap: No observed competitor states it verifies the output (EV-012/EV-014/EV-015)
notes: share-safe-app.mjs re-scans; keep this as the headline promise.

feature: PDF incremental revision detection; single-revision rewrite that drops unreachable old objects; removes Info/XMP/PieceInfo, attachments, document JavaScript and (optionally) comment annotations
competitor_gap: Competitors mention only 'properties'; ExifCleaner says its PDF removal is reversible (EV-016)
notes: Verified in pivot doc test (old text residue removed).

feature: Office hidden-content report: author/editor, company, template, edit time, custom properties, thumbnails, tracked changes incl. deleted text, comments, hidden text, hidden/very-hidden sheets, hidden rows/cols, external links, pivot caches, speaker notes, hidden slides, embedded objects, GPS in inserted photos
competitor_gap: Web competitors list only properties; Document Inspector requires desktop Office and per-file habit
notes: Reported, not auto-changed (deliberate: avoids corrupting documents).

feature: Optional Office content cleaning: delete comments, remove speaker notes, delete hidden/very-hidden sheets, clear custom properties and saved thumbnail, each as an explicit opt-in with re-scan
competitor_gap: Web tools do not touch Office hidden content; desktop Document Inspector does
dependency_risk: medium (OOXML relationship integrity; Excel repair prompts if references break)
notes: Current cleanOoxml only clears core/app properties. Ship sheet/notes/comments removal one type at a time with fixture tests; never accept/reject tracked changes automatically.

feature: Lossless JPEG/PNG/WebP metadata strip (EXIF GPS/serials/owner, XMP history, IPTC, PNG text chunks) keeping ICC profile and orientation
competitor_gap: Several tools re-encode through canvas (quality change); many are image-only
notes: Commodity on its own; keep as a supporting tab, not the headline.

feature: HAR/JSON/log/.env secret redaction (auth headers, cookies, JWT, bearer, URL tokens, private keys, AWS/GitHub/Stripe/Slack/Google keys, password-like JSON fields)
competitor_gap: Cloudflare HAR Sanitizer archived 2026-06-22; it targets HAR only
notes: Give HAR its own section/anchor with vendor-support wording ('your vendor asked for a HAR file').

feature: Batch mode: drop several files or a folder, one summary table, cleaned copies as a ZIP
competitor_gap: Proton limits batches; Drive add-on caps free use; current tool is single-file (input has no 'multiple')
notes: Unlocks 'check everything before publishing/sending' habit and website-PDF audits.

feature: Downloadable pre-send check report (what was found, what was removed, what remains, re-scan result, file hashes) as plain text/JSON
competitor_gap: No observed competitor offers a verification record
privacy_risk: medium (report must not include secret values; mask like the UI)
notes: Useful for paralegals/compliance as evidence of diligence; supports return use.

feature: 'Before you paste into AI' mode: paste text, detect secrets plus common PII (emails, phone numbers, ID-like numbers), replace with numbered placeholders and keep the mapping only in the page
competitor_gap: Extensions dominate; a page-based option with no install and visible offline proof is rare
privacy_risk: medium (must never transmit or store; detection only, no identity inference)
notes: Reuses scanText; adds a new acquisition angle without a new product.

feature: GPX/TCX/FIT route privacy trim: remove points within a chosen radius of start/finish or user-marked spots, strip device/creator fields, re-scan
competitor_gap: No online radius-based GPX tool found; FIT scrubber exists; platform privacy zones do not change files
dependency_risk: low (XML parsing; FIT needs a small binary parser)
privacy_risk: low (heart-rate/cadence is health-adjacent: offer removal only, never analysis)
notes: Small but clear audience; fits 'before you share'. Do GPX/TCX first, FIT later.

feature: HEIC/HEIF photo support
competitor_gap: MetaRemover and MetaStrip claim HEIC
dependency_risk: high (libheif wasm size; LGPL licensing; HEIC write-back is hard)
notes: Consider read-only HEIC GPS reporting first; keep the current honest message otherwise.

feature: PDF hidden-text checks: white/invisible text (render mode 3), text outside the visible page box, optional content layers that are switched off
competitor_gap: Not mentioned by any observed web competitor
notes: Partial 2026-11-27: invisible and white-on-white text on blank areas is caught by the FEAT-01 render check; off-page text and hidden optional-content layers are not. Pairs with FEAT-01; same pdf.js text-position work.

feature: MP4/MOV video GPS and device metadata
competitor_gap: MetaRemover and MetaStrip already cover video
dependency_risk: medium (ISO-BMFF box rewriting; large files in memory)
notes: Low differentiation; only if users ask.

feature: Office saved-thumbnail removal and custom-property clearing in the cleaned copy
competitor_gap: Web competitors do not mention thumbnails
notes: Currently reported as not cleanable (office-thumbnail, office-custom).

feature: Installable offline PWA with a visible 'network off' proof (works with Wi-Fi disabled) and Web Share Target so Android users can 'share to' the checker before sending
competitor_gap: Competitors assert local processing; few let users prove it
dependency_risk: low (service worker; Share Target is Chromium-Android only)
notes: Turns the privacy claim into something demonstrable; supports return use from the share sheet.

feature: Task-specific entry pages on the same engine (e.g. 'check a redacted PDF', 'sanitize a HAR file for support', 'find hidden sheets before sending Excel', 'trim home location from GPX'), each with original explanation and fixtures
competitor_gap: Competitors target the saturated 'remove metadata' query with one generic page
notes: Distribution feature: matches how people describe the job. Must be genuinely distinct pages with distinct functionality defaults, not doorway pages (AGENTS.md SEO rule).

feature: Pattern pack for AI-agent configs: Anthropic/OpenAI/Hugging Face and other LLM-provider key formats, claude_desktop_config.json and mcp.json env blocks; shared by file scan and the AI-paste mode
competitor_gap: Only CLI scanners cover this today
notes: Partial 2026-11-27 (eff533aa): Anthropic, OpenAI and Hugging Face key patterns added; mcp.json/claude_desktop_config.json env-block awareness not yet. Previously: current SECRET_PATTERNS has no LLM-provider key patterns; a cheap addition. Keep patterns conservative and never present 'nothing found' as 'safe'.

feature: Server-side processing or upload API for large files
competitor_gap: n/a
privacy_risk: high (contradicts the core promise; storage of user files)
notes: Violates the privacy-first rule and AGENTS.md; also removes the main reason to choose this tool.

feature: Cloud-LLM 'smart detection' of sensitive content
competitor_gap: n/a
privacy_risk: high (sends user content to a third party)
notes: Would undermine the local-only guarantee.

feature: Flatten filled PDF form fields in the cleaned copy (optional)
competitor_gap: Not mentioned by observed competitors
notes: Currently reported only (pdf-form).

feature: Encrypted PDF/Office handling with a locally typed password
competitor_gap: unknown
privacy_risk: medium (user types own password into a page; must be clearly local)
notes: Low priority; current message tells users to remove the password in the source app.
